SELECT
  pt.product_category_name_english AS product_category_name_english,
  AVG(ABS(oi.freight_value)) AS avg_freight_value,
  COUNT(DISTINCT LEFT(oi.order_id, 10)) AS order_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation pt
  ON p.product_category_name = pt.product_category_name
WHERE oi.freight_value IS NOT NULL
  AND pt.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY pt.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY pt.product_category_name_english;
